name: Street Custom 'Mantis' Spring-Loaded Wrist Blade
description: A concealed blade mechanism strapped to the inner forearm that deploys a 15cm steel blade with a spring-loaded snap triggered by wrist flexion. The Mantis is one of the oldest street weapon patterns in GLMZ — simple, reliable, and almost impossible to detect under a jacket sleeve. The blade extends in under 0.2 seconds and locks in position for use as a stabbing or slashing weapon, then retracts with a manual release. Quality ranges from precision-machined titanium builds that cost thousands to bent steel and rubber-band spring mechanisms that cost almost nothing. The pattern has been copied, modified, and reinvented so many times that no single origin can be traced.
specifications:
blade length: 12-18 cm depending on build
deployment time: 0.15-0.3 seconds
mechanism: Spring-loaded with wrist flexion trigger
retraction: Manual release lever
concealment: Under jacket or shirt sleeve
blade material: Steel, titanium, or ceramic depending on build
weight: 0.2-0.5 kg
construction: Ranges from machined precision to scrap improvisation
story_hooks: A ceramic-bladed Mantis was used to kill a target inside a high-security facility — the ceramic blade passed material scanning and the flexion trigger left no detectable mechanism on pat-down.
A Tier 1 community has developed a tradition where receiving a handmade Mantis from a mentor marks the transition to adulthood — the weapons are ceremonial but fully functional.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, low-profile forearm-mounted mechanism that hugs the inner wrist like a predator's skeletal limb. The blade sits flush against the arm when retracted, creating barely a bulge under fabric. When deployed, a wicked 15cm steel tooth snaps forward with mechanical precision.
physical_description.dimensions: Mechanism body: 18cm long × 4cm wide × 2.5cm deep when mounted. Blade extends 15cm total from wrist mount point. Mounting strap spans 12-16cm around forearm circumference.
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively light — feels like a heavy watch or slim bracer rather than a weapon. High-tier builds (titanium/precision) are nearly weightless; street-tier versions have noticeable heft from crude steel.
physical_description.primary_material: Machined steel or titanium frame depending on build tier. Blade is hardened steel or ceramic composite. Mounting strap is reinforced synthetic or leather.
physical_description.finish: High-tier: Brushed titanium with precision milling marks visible. Street-tier: Dull black oxide or rust-resistant coating with visible wear, tool marks, and improvised welds. Mid-tier: Matte gunmetal with subtle scratches from repeated deployment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: Matte black or gunmetal gray. Accent: Blade gleams cold silver or gun-blue depending on steel type. High-end builds show brushed metallic finishes.
physical_description.grip_texture: Mounting strap is rough textured — either knurled metal rivets, wraparound leather, or rubberized synthetic webbing for secure grip under the forearm without slipping during use.
distinctive_features: Spring mechanism housing with visible coil tension points
Wrist-flexion trigger—a small lever or pressure plate integrated into the inner forearm contact
Manual release button positioned for thumb access when blade is deployed
Blade retention teeth or locking groove visible when extended
Faint scratch patterns from thousands of micro-deployments in street builds
Heat discoloration on blade tip in well-used units (dark purple or bronze tint)
Quick-release buckle or clasp for emergency removal
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Street Custom: crude stamped initials 'SC' on housing (often worn illegible). High-tier builds may have serial numbers laser-etched inside the spring housing. Most street versions have no markings to avoid tracing.
physical_description.condition_typical: Street-tier: Scratched, slightly bent housing with visible rust spots on blade edges and dried blood stains in crevices. Mid-tier: Clean but worn, light scratches, blade shows minor discoloration. High-tier: Pristine, barely used, shows only faint handling marks.
